body.statement: Among the rules of the radius-5 square family that use an orbit of radius 5, count those whose nonzero eigenvalues at m = 37 are all ninth powers, that the atlas procedure (mechanisms 1 to 4) does not explain, and that are not images of rule 4850 under an invertible exponent map.
